temporal_coherence.question: Do the characters' facial features (face shape, eye colour, skin tone, hairstyle) remain consistent across consecutive shots?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Face is pixel-level consistent; clearly the same person in every shot.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Minor shifts at extreme angles, but still clearly recognisable as the same person.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Visible drift in proportions or skin tone; identity is plausible but questionable.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Faces look like different people in some shots.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Character face changes drastically between shots — effectively different characters.

temporal_coherence.question: Do characters' clothing, accessories, and body proportions stay consistent within the same scene (excluding intentional costume changes)?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Outfit colours, patterns, and fit are identical across shots in the same scene.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Very minor colour shade shift; overall outfit clearly the same.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Some clothing details change (e.g. pattern disappears, sleeve length changes).

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Outfit changes noticeably between shots with no narrative reason.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Completely different outfits between consecutive shots in the same scene.

temporal_coherence.question: Do objects held by or near characters persist correctly? (e.g. a cup doesn't vanish/appear spontaneously)
Is the background environment consistent within the same scene? (walls, furniture, landscape don't morph or change)

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Background is perfectly stable — identical layout, colours, and objects across shots in the same scene.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Background is recognisably the same; very minor texture changes only.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Background shifts noticeably (e.g. wall colour changes, furniture rearranges slightly).

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Background is different enough that continuity feels broken.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Background changes completely between shots in what should be the same scene.

temporal_coherence.question: Do the relative sizes and proportions of people/objects remain physically plausible across shots?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: All sizes are physically consistent — no distortion.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Proportions are mostly correct; minor camera-angle-induced differences only.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Some objects or characters appear to change size without justification.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Obvious size inconsistencies (e.g. a person is much larger/smaller between cuts).

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Severe proportion errors — objects or people resize dramatically.

temporal_coherence.question: Is the direction and speed of motion continuous across cuts? (no teleportation or sudden direction reversal without cause)
When time progression is implied (day→night, season change), is it logically justified by the narrative?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: All time jumps are clearly signalled and narratively motivated.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Time jumps are plausible; minor ambiguity about duration.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Some time shifts feel abrupt or under-motivated.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Confusing temporal jumps that undermine coherence.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Time progression is nonsensical (e.g. night→day→night in seconds with no reason).

lighting_consistency.question: Is the direction of the key light source consistent across shots within the same scene?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Shadows and highlights consistently indicate the same light source direction.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Light direction is mostly consistent; very minor shifts.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Light direction shifts between some shots without justification.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Light direction is frequently inconsistent.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Light comes from obviously different directions in consecutive same-scene shots.

lighting_consistency.question: Are shadows physically plausible and consistent with the light sources shown?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Shadows are physically accurate and match the light source in every shot.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Shadows are mostly correct; minor inconsistencies.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Some shadows are misaligned or missing where they should be.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Shadows frequently contradict the visible light source.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Shadows are absent, inverted, or nonsensical.

lighting_consistency.question: Is the colour temperature (warm/cool) consistent within the same scene, without unjustified sudden shifts?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Colour temperature is uniform throughout each scene.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Very slight colour temperature drift that most viewers wouldn't notice.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Visible warm↔cool shift between shots in the same scene.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Jarring colour temperature changes.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Scene oscillates wildly between warm and cool tones.

lighting_consistency.question: Is the exposure/brightness level stable, without sudden flashes or darkening?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Exposure is perfectly stable across all shots in each scene.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Minor exposure variation that doesn't distract.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Some shots are noticeably brighter/darker than neighbours.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Frequent brightness jumps.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Severe flashing or extreme exposure changes between cuts.

script_reasonableness.question: Does each story event logically follow from the previous one, with plausible cause-and-effect?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Every transition between events is causally motivated — no plot holes.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Cause-and-effect is mostly clear; one minor logical stretch.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Some events feel disconnected or require viewer inference to connect.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Multiple events lack causal connection; narrative feels random.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Events are entirely disconnected — no coherent story.

script_reasonableness.question: Do characters act with plausible motivations? (actions make sense given what we know about them)

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Every character action feels motivated and in-character.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Motivations are mostly clear; one action feels slightly arbitrary.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Some character actions feel unmotivated or out-of-character.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Characters frequently do things that contradict their established behaviour.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Characters act randomly with no discernible motivation.

script_reasonableness.question: Does the narrative have a clear beginning-middle-end structure with appropriate pacing for a ~1 minute video?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Clear setup→conflict→resolution arc; pacing feels natural for the duration.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Structure is recognisable; pacing is slightly uneven.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Structure is loose — story meanders or rushes.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: No clear structure; feels like a random sequence of events.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: No narrative arc whatsoever.

script_reasonableness.question: Are there any internal contradictions? (e.g. a character is said to be alone but others are present, time of day contradicts dialogue)
Is the dialogue (if any) natural, context-appropriate, and free of unintentional repetition?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Dialogue sounds natural and advances the story.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Dialogue is mostly natural; minor awkwardness.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Some lines feel wooden, repetitive, or out of place.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Dialogue frequently sounds unnatural or robotic.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Dialogue is incomprehensible or completely unnatural.

script_novelty.question: Is the core premise/concept original or surprising, rather than a common cliché?

rubric.label: Highly original
rubric.description: Premise is fresh, surprising, and unlikely to have been seen before.

rubric.label: Somewhat original
rubric.description: Interesting twist on a known concept.

rubric.label: Average
rubric.description: Standard premise — not cliché but not surprising.

rubric.label: Derivative
rubric.description: Heavily borrows from well-known templates.

rubric.label: Cliché
rubric.description: Extremely predictable, overused concept.

script_novelty.question: Does the story contain any unexpected turns, reveals, or creative choices that keep the viewer engaged?

rubric.label: Highly surprising
rubric.description: Multiple genuinely unexpected moments that feel earned.

rubric.label: Some surprise
rubric.description: At least one notable surprise element.

rubric.label: Predictable
rubric.description: Story proceeds as expected without surprises.

rubric.label: Very predictable
rubric.description: Every beat is telegraphed far in advance.

rubric.label: No engagement
rubric.description: Completely flat — no creative choices whatsoever.

script_novelty.question: Are there creative visual storytelling techniques? (unusual angles, metaphorical imagery, creative transitions)

rubric.label: Highly creative
rubric.description: Inventive visual language that enhances the narrative.

rubric.label: Some creativity
rubric.description: A few interesting visual choices.

rubric.label: Standard
rubric.description: Competent but conventional visual approach.

rubric.label: Uninspired
rubric.description: Generic visual presentation.

rubric.label: Flat
rubric.description: No visual storytelling — static and lifeless.

bgm_consistency.question: Does the background music mood match the visual/narrative mood of each scene?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Music mood perfectly complements every scene's emotional tone.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Music mood mostly matches; minor misalignment in one scene.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Music feels generic — not mismatched but not enhancing either.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Music mood clashes with the visual mood in some scenes.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Music is completely wrong for the content (e.g. upbeat during tragedy).

bgm_consistency.question: Do music transitions between scenes feel smooth, without abrupt cuts or jarring volume changes?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Music transitions are seamless — crossfades or natural breakpoints.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Transitions are mostly smooth; one minor audible cut.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Some music cuts are noticeable but not jarring.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Music frequently cuts abruptly at scene changes.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Harsh audio cuts or overlapping tracks at every transition.

bgm_consistency.question: Does the music tempo/rhythm match the pacing of the visual action?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Tempo mirrors the action pacing — builds during intense moments, relaxes during calm.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Tempo is appropriate; one segment feels slightly mismatched.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Tempo is constant and doesn't adapt to pacing changes.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Tempo actively contradicts the visual pacing.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Music rhythm is completely out of sync with the visual action.

bgm_consistency.question: Is the BGM volume balanced against dialogue/narration? (not drowning out speech, not inaudible)

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Music ducks appropriately under dialogue; perfectly balanced.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Balance is good; music occasionally slightly loud.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Music sometimes competes with dialogue.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Dialogue is hard to hear over the music in multiple scenes.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Music completely drowns out or is entirely absent during dialogue.

narration_reasonableness.question: Does speech start and end at natural points? (no cut-off mid-word, no awkward silence gaps)

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: All speech segments start and end cleanly at natural sentence/phrase boundaries.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Speech timing is mostly natural; one minor clipping.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Some speech is cut off or has unnatural pauses.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Frequent mid-word cuts or awkwardly long gaps.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Speech is severely clipped, overlapping, or has nonsensical timing.

narration_reasonableness.question: Does the vocal emotion/tone match the scene's mood? (e.g. not cheerful during a sad scene)

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Vocal emotion precisely matches the scene's mood in every segment.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Emotion is mostly appropriate; one segment feels slightly off.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Vocal emotion is flat/neutral regardless of scene mood.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Vocal emotion clashes with the scene mood in some segments.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Vocal emotion is completely wrong (e.g. laughing during crisis).

narration_reasonableness.question: Is the speech clearly intelligible? (no garbling, mumbling, or AI-artefact distortion)

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Every word is crystal clear and easily understood.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Almost all speech is clear; one or two words are slightly unclear.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Some phrases are hard to understand without replaying.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Significant portions are garbled or distorted.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Speech is largely unintelligible.

generation_stability.question: How frequently do visual artefacts appear? (flickering, warping, morphing, ghosting)

rubric.label: Clean
rubric.description: No visible artefacts throughout the entire video.

rubric.label: Rare
rubric.description: 1-2 very brief artefacts that most viewers would miss.

rubric.label: Occasional
rubric.description: Artefacts appear in a few scenes but don't dominate.

rubric.label: Frequent
rubric.description: Artefacts in many scenes; distracting.

rubric.label: Pervasive
rubric.description: Constant artefacts throughout — nearly unwatchable.

generation_stability.question: Is the video sharp and well-resolved, or does it appear blurry/soft?

rubric.label: Sharp
rubric.description: Crisp detail throughout; looks like a professional render.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Mostly sharp; minor softness in some areas.

rubric.label: Soft
rubric.description: Noticeably softer than expected for the resolution.

rubric.label: Blurry
rubric.description: Significant blur that obscures detail.

rubric.label: Very blurry
rubric.description: Extremely blurry — looks like a low-resolution upscale.

generation_stability.question: Does the video quality degrade over time? (e.g. second half is blurrier, more artefacts than first half)

rubric.label: Stable
rubric.description: Quality is consistent from start to finish.

rubric.label: Slight
rubric.description: Very minor quality drop in the last few seconds.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Visible quality degradation in the second half.

rubric.label: Significant
rubric.description: Second half is markedly worse than the first.

rubric.label: Severe
rubric.description: Quality collapses dramatically — last portion is barely recognisable.

generation_stability.question: Are colours natural and consistent? (no random colour banding, posterisation, or saturation spikes)

rubric.label: Natural
rubric.description: Colours are natural, well-graded, and consistent.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Colours are mostly natural; very minor inconsistency.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Some colour banding or saturation issues visible.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Frequent colour artefacts.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Severe posterisation, banding, or colour corruption.

generation_stability.question: Does the video reach the expected duration (~60 seconds) without cutting short or having frozen/repeated frames at the end?

text_video_consistency.question: Are the key scenes/events described in the script visually present in the video?

rubric.label: All present
rubric.description: Every scripted scene is visually realised.

rubric.label: Mostly present
rubric.description: One minor scripted detail is missing or vague.

rubric.label: Partial
rubric.description: Some scripted scenes are present; others are missing or replaced.

rubric.label: Sparse
rubric.description: Only a few scripted scenes appear; much of the script is not reflected.

rubric.label: Absent
rubric.description: The video bears almost no resemblance to the script.

text_video_consistency.question: Do the scripted events appear in the correct temporal order in the video?
Do the characters' visual appearance (gender, age, attire) match the script descriptions?

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Characters perfectly match script descriptions in every detail.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Characters are recognisable from descriptions; minor deviations.

rubric.label: Partial
rubric.description: Some character attributes match; others are noticeably different.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Characters look quite different from descriptions.

rubric.label: Mismatched
rubric.description: Characters bear no resemblance to script descriptions.

text_video_consistency.question: Does the video contain significant visual elements NOT mentioned in the script? (hallucination check)

rubric.label: Faithful
rubric.description: No hallucinated content — everything shown is scripted.

rubric.label: Minor extras
rubric.description: One or two extra details that don't contradict the script.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: Some unscripted elements appear but don't dominate.

rubric.label: Significant
rubric.description: Major unscripted elements that confuse the narrative.

rubric.label: Hallucinated
rubric.description: Video is full of content not in the script.

text_video_consistency.question: Do the visual settings/locations match the script descriptions? (indoor/outdoor, time of day, weather)

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Every setting precisely matches script descriptions.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Settings are mostly accurate; minor environmental differences.

rubric.label: Partial
rubric.description: Some settings match; others are noticeably different.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Most settings don't match descriptions.

rubric.label: Wrong
rubric.description: Settings are completely different from what the script describes.

video_audio_consistency.question: When characters speak, do their lip movements match the audio timing?

rubric.label: Perfect sync
rubric.description: Lip movements precisely match audio — professional quality.

rubric.label: Good sync
rubric.description: Lips are mostly in sync; very slight delay/advance.

rubric.label: Noticeable lag
rubric.description: Visible but tolerable desynchronisation.

rubric.label: Poor sync
rubric.description: Obvious mismatch between lip movement and audio.

rubric.label: No sync
rubric.description: Lips move independently of audio — like a badly dubbed film.

video_audio_consistency.question: Do sound effects match the visual events that produce them? (e.g. door slam → bang sound at the right moment)

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Every visual event has a matching, well-timed sound effect.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Most events are properly accompanied; one minor timing issue.

rubric.label: Partial
rubric.description: Some events have sounds, others are silent or mistimed.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Frequent mismatches between sounds and visual events.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Sounds bear no relation to visual events.

video_audio_consistency.question: Is the audio continuous across shot transitions? (no abrupt cuts, pops, or silence gaps)

rubric.label: Seamless
rubric.description: Audio flows naturally across all transitions.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: One minor audio hiccup at a transition.

rubric.label: Noticeable
rubric.description: A few audible cuts or pops at transitions.

rubric.label: Poor
rubric.description: Frequent audio discontinuities.

rubric.label: Broken
rubric.description: Audio cuts out, pops, or glitches at most transitions.

video_audio_consistency.question: Does the ambient audio match the visual environment? (e.g. outdoor sounds for outdoor scenes)

rubric.label: Perfect
rubric.description: Ambient audio perfectly matches every visual environment.

rubric.label: Good
rubric.description: Ambient is mostly appropriate; one scene feels slightly off.

rubric.label: Generic
rubric.description: Ambient audio is present but generic — doesn't enhance immersion.

rubric.label: Mismatched
rubric.description: Ambient audio clashes with the visual environment.

rubric.label: Absent/wrong
rubric.description: No ambient audio, or completely wrong ambience.
